notes.title: Deathbound Launch Sale
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce the launch of our exciting new party-based soulslike game, Deathbound! To celebrate this epic release, we're kicking off a RELEASE CELEBRATION SALE across our entire game portfolio.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/tatemultimedia/sale/deathboundlaunchsale][h3]Deathbound Release Celebaration Sale[/h3][/url]

Save 50% on Kao the Kangaroo (2000 re-release) and up to 90% on our other titles! Challenge yourself with the brand-new soulslike experience and embark on a crusade through the forbidden city of Akratya with an exclusive launch discount!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948138/efb9c6bccc157339d765925edc4274df15541c0e.png[/img]

[h3]More about Deathbound[/h3]
Deathbound is a one-of-a-kind party-based soulslike set in a callous world where Faith and Science clash. Dynamically transform between fallen warriors all with their own unique skill sets, combat styles, and rich history. Conquer a brutal reality where Life and Death were never more conflicted.

[h3]Grab Deathbound now and dive into a brutal and divided future where Death and Life were never more conflicted...[/h3]
